using System;
using Etl.Core.Abstractions;
using LoadEmployees.Csv;
using LoadEmployees.Mapping;
using LoadEmployees.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace LoadEmployees.Tests;

public class EmployeeTransformTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Map_ComputesExpectedOutput_ForARepresentativeRow()
    {
        var row = new EmployeeCsvRow
        {
            EmployeeID = 7,
            Department = "Sample",
            HireDate = new DateOnly(2020, 6, 15),
            Salary = 7.5m,
            FirstName = "Sample",
            LastName = "Sample",
            City = "Sample",
            State = "Sample",
        };
        var ctx = new RowContext(RowNumber: 1, LoadedAtUtc: new DateTime(2020, 6, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), SourceName: "EmployeeTransform");

        var result = new EmployeeTransform().Map(row, ctx);

        Assert.Equal(7, result.EmployeeID);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", result.Department);
        Assert.Equal(new DateOnly(2020, 6, 15), result.HireDate);
        Assert.Equal(7.5m, result.Salary);
        // FullName <- (DT_WSTR,101)(FirstName + " " + LastName)
        Assert.Equal("Sample Sample", result.FullName);
        // Location <- (DT_WSTR,60)(City + ", " + State)
        Assert.Equal("Sample, Sample", result.Location);
        // EmployeeKey <- (DT_WSTR,20)(UPPER(SUBSTRING(Department,1,3)) + "-" + (DT_WSTR,10)EmployeeID)
        Assert.Equal("SAM-7", result.EmployeeKey);
        // LoadedAtUtc <- GETUTCDATE()
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2020, 6, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), result.LoadedAtUtc);
    }
}
